prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, insurance issues, and the kind of lawyer you want (settlement-focused vs. trial-ready). I can help you find the best match, but here are practical steps and resources to quickly identify strong candidates in Chicago.

What to look for
- Primary focus on car-accident/personal-injury work (not a general practice).  
- Significant experience handling similar injuries and insurance issues.  
- Trial experience (many cases settle, but a lawyer who can and will try the case gets better settlements).  
- Track record of verdicts/settlements and verifiable client reviews.  
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (no upfront fees; typical contingency 33–40%).  
- Good communication: who will handle your file day-to-day, expected updates, response time.  
- Willingness to get medical care arranged and handle liens/subrogation.  
- Professional recognitions (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV rating, peer awards) are helpful but not decisive.

Where to search
- Chicago Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service.  
- Illinois State Bar Association referrals.  
- SuperLawyers.com (Chicago list), Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (client reviews + lawyer answers).  
- American Association for Justice (AAJ) member lists for plaintiff trial lawyers.  
- Local hospital or medical provider recommendations (they often refer experienced PI attorneys).

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases do you handle per year?  
- What percent of your practice is personal injury?  
- Have you handled cases like mine (type/severity of injury, complicated liability)? Can you share outcomes?  
- Do you try cases if needed? How many jury trials in the last 5 years?  
- Who will actually handle my case day-to-day? Will you or a junior attorney/paralegal?  
- How do you charge (contingency %, costs advanced, when are costs repaid)?  
- What is your estimate for my case and why?  
- How often will I get updates? How do you prefer to communicate?

Next steps I can do for you
- If you want, tell me: ZIP code, brief case facts (date of crash, injuries, fault/insurance situation), and any preferences (trial lawyer, bilingual, budget). I’ll pull a short list (3–5 highly rated Chicago personal-injury attorneys/firms that match your needs) with contact info and why they may be a good fit.

Would you like me to find a few specific attorneys near you? If so, please share your ZIP code and any case details you’re comfortable providing.
